status: Linux Arch x86_64 XDMCP candidate; explicit inbound listener policy required; native Windows/macOS unqualified
network_policy: Default deny. XDMCP requires explicit per-session permission for upstream all-interface inbound TCP. -from only selects advertised/source address; it does not constrain the TCP listener. Never -ac. XDMCP and X11 remain unencrypted and discovery unauthenticated.
clipboard: Host keyboard with disabled clipboard uses stock Xephyr. An explicit layout or bidirectional clipboard selects the separately pinned session-ready engine. Only bidirectional clipboard opens the parent clipboard endpoint.
native_gaps: Private VcXsrv and XQuartz candidate engines require dedicated XDMCP network/authorization adapters and real native qualification. Never automatic installed-client fallback.

fixture.scope: Tests only, unshare user/PID/network + private TEST-NET veth + Cage; no PAM login, host display manager or network changes

clipboard_engine.readiness: display number, then session-ready-v1 after XDMCP session socket selection, then EOF
clipboard_engine.keyboard: Single registered evdev layout ID, applied to the nested master and KDrive keyboard each generation. Uses the installed xorg-xkbcomp and xkeyboard-config. Host inheritance when omitted.
clipboard_engine.lifecycle: Explicit bidirectional-clipboard option excludes only authenticated local clients with exact live launching-parent PID and UID from XDMCP first-client session ownership; pidfd plus current parent identity retained. All native authorization and ordinary client accounting remain enabled.
